rawContent: Then there are the stories I haven't told that return like an unwanted guest. His girlfriend told me about their sex life. I was 8. Then he tried to show me what that looked like. I am sitting here wondeing where the adults were in my life. #metoo #CSASurvivors
Then there are douche bags like this. And we wonder why we have #metoo #churchtoo and all the sex scandals. https://t.co/Z4Q80T5SC2

@sololoner2 @sheilagregoire @wartwatch I had this conversation in the office today. The guy is worried that #metoo involving "inappropriate touching or conversations " hurts those who have been abused or assaulted. I get his passion. After all, he knows the pain as a victim himself.
@loistoyou @mark_earnest @kizabrat @Farr_Szar @nytimes I noticed a LOT of the #metoo were your generation. That made me smile. I know many who have been silent because that's what you did.
Remember this please. No survivor owes you their story, including explanation why they stayed silent or spoke up. #metoo #churchtoo #CSASurvivors #sexualabuse #nomoore #believeus

@casabeca @DefendTheSheep @bivopastor This year has been hard with the #metoo and #churchtoo. Taking my 16 year old to a college tour yesterday was painful. The me who desperately wanted to believe what they told me was wrong was angry. I wasn't supposed to live past 19.
